# INTC fiscal 2013 annual report (10-K), page 29

Authoritative, audited figures.

Item 1b. Unresolved staff comments not applicable. Item 2. Properties as of december 28, 2013, our major facilities consisted of: (square feet in millions) united states countries total owned facilities1 29.9 16.7 46.6 leased facilities2 2.3 6.0 8.3.

| (Square Feet in Millions) | UnitedStates | OtherCountries | Total |
|---|---|---|---|
| Owned facilities<sup>1</sup> | 29.9 | 16.7 | 46.6 |
| Leased facilities<sup>2</sup> | 2.3 | 6.0 | 8.3 |
| Total facilities | 32.2 | 22.7 | 54.9 |

1 leases on portions of the land used for these facilities expire on varying dates through 2062. 2 leases expire on varying dates through 2028 and generally include renewals at our option. Our principal executive offices are located in the u.s. And a significant amount of our wafer fabrication activities are also located in the u.s. In addition to our current facilities, we are building a development fabrication facility in oregon which began r&d start-up in 2013. We expect that this new facility will allow us to widen our process technology lead. We also completed construction of a large-scale fabrication building in arizona in 2013, which is currently not in use and is not being depreciated. We recently announced that we plan to delay equipment installation in this building and leverage existing fabrication facilities, reserving this new facility for additional capacity and future technologies. Outside the u.s., we have wafer fabrication facilities in israel, china, and ireland. Our fabrication facility in ireland is currently transitioning to a newer process technology node, with manufacturing expected to recommence in 2015. Our assembly and test facilities are located in malaysia, china, costa rica, and vietnam. In addition, we have sales and marketing offices worldwide that are generally located near major concentrations of customers. We believe that the facilities described above are suitable and adequate for our present purposes and that the productive capacity in our facilities is substantially being utilized or we have plans to utilize it.

# INTC Fiscal 2013 Figures

## Facilities Data

### United States
- **Owned Facilities**: 29.9 million square feet (Source: 10-K, page 29)
- **Total Facilities**: 32.2 million square feet (Source: 10-K, page 29)

### Other Countries
- **Total Facilities**: 22.7 million square feet (Source: 10-K, page 29)
- **Leased Facilities**: 6.0 million square feet (Source: 10-K, page 29)

## Calculation

To find the percentage of owned facilities in the US out of the total US facilities:

\[ \text{Percentage} = \left( \frac{\text{Owned Facilities (US)}}{\text{Total Facilities (US)}} \right) \times 100 \]

\[ \text{Percentage} = \left( \frac{29.9}{32.2} \right) \times 100 \approx 92.86\% \]

### Summary
- **Owned Facilities (US)**: 29.9 million square feet
- **Total Facilities (US)**: 32.2 million square feet
- **Percentage of Owned Facilities in the US**: 92.86%

All figures are from the INTC fiscal 2013 annual report (10-K), page 29.
